finalText:
All 625 tests pass now.

The bug: `orderTotal()` in `src/pricing.js` was computing tax on the pre-discount amount (`cents * taxRate`) instead of the discounted amount, contradicting its own doc comment ("tax what's actually owed"). It only showed up in the `order totals` suite's 3 rows where both a discount and a tax rate were non-zero. Fixed to tax `discounted` instead of `cents`.
